title: Validate ordinary EUR fixed OBJ transfer under Wine
changes: Verify ordinary startup use of the existing E135 fixed OBJ transfer with interpreter and translated execution.
validation: A protected continuation of ordinary EUR startup observes the original queue call with source 08b80b5c, destination 06010000 and count 4000h, and retains the pre-call state: e135-ordinary-observer-wine-s462xxqw.

Wine raw/managed interpreter and translated pairs pass exact 32 KiB VRAM, three full state and clock comparisons each, with the managed source ROM poisoned; 48608 aggregate raw transfer bytes include E136: e135-ordinary-pair-wine-jjgeygm9.

Initial observer build e135-ordinary-observer-build-pjhllipr failed before compilation because the script path was relative to validation scratch; the corrected build e135-ordinary-observer-build-w_4gg37c passed.
limitations: One ordinary startup route; other scenes, UI save/Load, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
